payload: Replace the tomato with a banana. Use a textured YCB 011 asset if available, otherwise model the curved profile and yellow skin in Blender.
receptacle: Replace the steel bowl with a low, teal glazed ceramic bowl with a distinct rim. Keep its outer diameter within about 20 percent of the source.
layout: Change the fruit-to-bowl vector visibly in world XY. Aim for at least 8 cm of vector change, and an initial center spacing of 18–32 cm. Check edge clearance and reachability.
interaction: Grasp the fruit between both pads, lift, carry, release inside the bowl and withdraw while the fruit remains in it.
